name: Fabric of All Being
description: An ancient artifact holding the fates of all things, used by the Drix to unlock weftwalking.

description_citations.text: "Drix". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: An ancient artifact predating the Fomori-Eldrazi conflict, kept on the Drix beam world, containing the fates of all things and used to unlock weftwalking and identify Eldrazi potential.
